verdict.rationale: A data-use and AI-training privacy posture is a fair question for any app that handles user sessions and files, including a terminal or SSH client, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only SSH/Mosh, keys, UI and keyboard features, and contains no statement about AI training, data-use policies or opt-out controls.
